takes.note: A is the bait: she walks into the panic room and stands on the latch. The hatch locks behind her, the stalker wakes, and because she is the farthest self it runs the length of the room and parks on the rail in front of her wall.

B is the broom: half speed, so her heavy swing shoves without hurting. She waits out of the sentry's sight until it has just looked (beat 6), walks up behind the parked stalker and bats it down the rail onto the socket. The sentry has seen her by then: the bolt it fires at her on beat 11 hits its colleague, which is standing between them again.

plan.note: the sentry picks its target on beats 2, 6, 10 ...: step out just after one
walks back out along the row: the bolt fired at her on beat 11 meets the stalker first

takes.note: C waits at the shutter, goes through while the stunned stalker sits on the socket, and wakes the amp with a 2x heavy.

notes: Objective complete at beat 12.04: Wake the amp.
Tape B's heavy at beat 10.56 hit stalker but did no damage (no damage, momentum 0.9).
Survivors: Tape A, Tape B, Tape C.
